# Contract Model

## Purpose
The Contract Model manages legal and business agreements between entities, including items covered by the contract and associated charges.

## Key Entities
- **Contract**: The main agreement entity.
- **ContractItem**: A specific item or service covered under the contract.
- **ContractItemChargeReference**: References charges associated with a contract item.

## Class Diagram
```mermaid
classDiagram
    Baseclass <|-- Contract
    Baseclass <|-- ContractItem
    Baseclass <|-- ContractItemChargeReference
    Contract "1" *-- "many" ContractItem
    ContractItem "1" -- "many" ContractItemChargeReference

    class Contract {
        +String name
        +String description
        +OffsetDateTime startTime
        +OffsetDateTime endTime
    }
    class ContractItem {
        +Contract contract
    }
    class ContractItemChargeReference {
        +ContractItem contractItem
        +ChargeReference chargeReference
    }
```
